lineage: README: It was forked from the excellent project by @MattKallada. LICENSE credits cesar.gomes and mirrorballu2 for 2007-2011; pyproject authors also list Cesar Gomes Miguel, Carolina Feher da Silva, Marcio Lobo Netto. Implements NEAT by Kenneth O. Stanley (Stanley & Miikkulainen 2002). v2.0 was a breaking CTRNN API change (per-node evolvable time constants); v2.1 adds paper-compliance options and optional CuPy GPU evaluation. examples/xor/README.md references Izhikevich 2003 'Simple model of spiking neurons' for the spiking example. || main loop (reader, from the code): Population.run repeats, for up to n generations: call the user fitness_function on all (id, genome) pairs, find the best and stop if fitness_criterion over the population meets fitness_threshold, otherwise build the next population with DefaultReproduction.reproduce (drop stagnant species, allocate spawn by adjusted fitness, keep elites, pick parents from the top survival_threshold fraction, crossover then mutate), reset on extinction if configured, then re-speciate by compatibility distance and increment generation.

entry_points: neat/population.py Population.run(fitness_function, n=None) (the generational loop: evaluate all genomes via the user callback, check fitness threshold, reproduce, handle extinction, speciate, repeat; returns best genome)

neat/reproduction.py DefaultReproduction.reproduce(config, species, pop_size, generation) (stagnation filtering, adjusted-fitness spawn allocation, elitism, survival-threshold parent pool, random parent choice with optional interspecies crossover, crossover then mutate per child, records ancestors)
neat/genome.py DefaultGenome.mutate / configure_crossover / distance (structural add/delete node and connection mutations, gene-level crossover with innovation matching, compatibility distance)

neat/species.py DefaultSpeciesSet.speciate(config, population, generation) (assigns genomes to species by compatibility distance to representatives; optional dynamic threshold toward target_num_species)
neat/stagnation.py DefaultStagnation.update(species_set, generation, config) (marks species stagnant after max_stagnation generations without improvement, protecting species_elitism)
neat/config.py Config(genome_type, reproduction_type, species_set_type, stagnation_type, filename) (parses the INI-style config file; is_better_fitness/meets_threshold honour fitness_criterion)
neat/nn/feed_forward.py FeedForwardNetwork.create(genome, config) (phenotype construction used by the examples)
